contexts.text: Why standest thou without? () = somewhat therefrom. Explained.
If (there) people stand outside (the house) their thoughts are indeed perceived, but as from some one else.
Without are dogs... ()... Those are said to be without when they are outside Heaven or the Church. AR 952.
Such cannot look into truths themselves; they stand without...
This he does abroad, the other at home.
For those in falsities stand without, while those in truths are in the house.
Without shall the sword bereave () = that falsity and evil from the internal will devastate both the natural and the rational man.
